keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Pequannock Township, homeowners pay an average of $12,285.7 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 9.36% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 81.4%, assessed values average ~81.4% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 63.8% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 26.4%, and Morris County claims 9.8%.
